name: Borys Tugovoy-Karlik
description:
Bear is six-foot-five before the augmentation and six-foot-eight after. The augmentation is Tier 5 throughout — Arcturus Defense Solutions chassis at the spine and shoulders, IRONLIMB titanium spinal column, Helix Biosystems pressure suit integrated under the skin. He carries a Fenris Ballistics Howl-2 squad automatic and a CRUCIBLE Vantage precision sidearm and on contracts that warrant it a Korova Arms support rifle. He looks like a piece of corponation security infrastructure that has somehow detached from its assigned post and started taking freelance work, which is exactly what he is, and which is exactly what he tells anyone who asks.

Bear served twelve years in Arcturus Defense Solutions corporate security before the contract that put him in front of a court-martial board he was not going to win on the merits. He walked off the base, kept the augmentation (it had been paid for out of his salary advance and was, by Arcturus's own contracts, his personal property), and has been a freelancer for eight years. Arcturus has not pursued him. Bear suspects Arcturus has decided he is more useful loose than in a cell. Bear has not bothered to confirm this suspicion.
heritage: Cossack-Inuit. Father's family from the Don river delta via the climate-collapse migrations of the 2130s. Mother's family from Iqaluit via the polar-zone resettlement programs. Speaks Russian, Inuktitut, English. Wrote poetry in his twenties; will not discuss this.
specialty: heavy-weapons operation; sustained-fire combat; vehicle interdiction; squad-level fire coordination; the kind of contract where the contractor has read the brief and concluded that what is needed is *more weight, applied longer*
method: deploys as the heavy element on multi-operator contracts. Does not run solo work that requires stealth or social engineering. Does not pretend to. Knows what he is good for and does not bid on contracts outside that scope.
code: the contract is the contract; the team is the team; the weapon stays in the holster until the team's lead says otherwise. He does not freelance for the same corponation that court-martialed him. He does not work child-harvester contracts. He does not work slaver contracts. Within those limits he will work for anyone whose Φ clears.
signature_gear: Fenris Ballistics Howl-2 SAW; CRUCIBLE Vantage Precision Sidearm; Arcturus Defense Solutions integrated chassis (the augmentation he kept from his service years); a pressure-rated coat he had custom-tailored to accommodate the chassis; a small notebook of poetry he does not show anyone
relationship_to_kyle: professional and respectful. They have worked together twice. Bear thinks of Kyle as *the man with the sword* and considers Kyle competent in a way Bear's own training had not anticipated; Bear has spent two years telling himself the swordsman thing is a gimmick and has, after the second contract, stopped telling himself this. Kyle thinks of Bear as the operator who arrives where Bear is needed and leaves when Bear is no longer needed. They have not had a conversation that lasted more than fourteen minutes. They have not needed to.
aesthetic: large, heavy, deliberately calm. The augmentation is visible at the shoulders under any clothing. He wears layers that do not advertise the chassis but do not pretend it isn't there. Walks slowly because walking slowly is what large men learn to do when they want to stop registering as a threat.
spin_off_hook: A corponation has decided the eight-year statute on Bear's court-martial has expired in a way that lets them re-open the case. The corporation that has decided this is not Arcturus. It is a competitor of Arcturus that has acquired the original court-martial documents through a Pulse-corridor data leak and that has concluded that Bear, alive and freelance and visible in GLMZ, represents an opportunity for a public legal action that would damage Arcturus's reputation. Bear gets a tip and has eight hours to decide what to do about it. The story is what he does.
